# SEO-241: Describe the video truthfully in its title and summary

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| --- | --- |

| Minimum level | `RECOMMENDED` |

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

The name and description supplied for a video, in visible text and in any markup, describe the video that actually plays on the page and do not promise content it does not contain.

## Rationale

A description that overstates the video is a claim about the page's content that the page then fails to honour, and the mismatch is what a viewer discovers after committing to watch.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "has_video"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Take both values from the same record the page displays, so editing one changes both. An automated agent must not compose or extend a description of media it has not examined, and should report the missing value instead.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Compare the marked-up name and description against the visible heading and summary on the same page and against the media the page embeds.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `MANUAL_ACTION`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `GOOGLE_VIDEO`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
